activeQuestion.prompt: Why is the platform on the paper ticket unreliable?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 為什麼不能依照紙票上的月台資訊？

options.text: Engineers have repaired the signals ahead of schedule.
options.zh: 工程師已提早修好號誌。
options.whyZh: 公告只說預期修復，並未表示已完成。

options.text: The track closure has left the departure platform undecided.
options.zh: 軌道關閉，出發月台尚未確定。
options.whyZh: 號誌故障使軌道關閉；目前列車無法進站且新月台未定，不能依紙票前往。

options.text: Staff have confirmed that the train will leave from platform six.
options.zh: 站方已確認列車將從六號月台出發。
options.whyZh: 公告明確要求不要前往紙票上的六號月台。

options.text: Passengers must exchange paper tickets for new ones.
options.whyZh: 指示是看電子看板，並未要求換票。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 號誌故障使軌道關閉；目前列車無法進站且新月台未定，不能依紙票前往。
activeQuestion.evidence: A signal fault has closed the eastern tracks | we cannot yet confirm a departure platform | Please do not proceed to platform six, which is shown on printed tickets.

vocabulary.note: 列車出發的月台；這班車尚未確認。
已事先預訂、銜接本班列車的後續交通。

options.whyZh: 東側軌道因號誌故障關閉。

originalQuestion.explanationZh: 東側軌道因號誌故障關閉。
originalQuestion.evidence: A signal fault has closed the eastern tracks

vocabulary.note: 錯過轉乘後繼續前往目的地的交通。

group.title: Changes to a train service
group.passage: M1: Passengers for the ten fifteen train to Northbridge, please stay in the main waiting area. A signal fault has closed the eastern tracks. No departure platform is confirmed. Do not go to platform six, even if your ticket says to. Check the electronic boards instead. If this delay makes you miss a booked connection, the information desk can arrange your onward trip at no extra charge. Our next update is at ten twenty.
group.passageZh: 搭乘十點十五分前往北橋的旅客，請留在主要候車區。號誌故障已造成東側軌道封閉。出發月台尚未確認。即使車票上寫著第六月台，也請不要前往，改看電子看板。如果這次延誤讓您錯過已預訂的轉乘，服務台可免費為您安排後續行程。下次更新在十點二十分。
